what: Plan does not pin $BUG_TMPDIR under canonical /tmp
scenario_or_breakage: The skill registers deny-edit-write.sh (Write allowed only under /tmp) and composes bug-issue-body.md via Write, but Step 2 only says setup $BUG_TMPDIR without a path contract; copying session-setup or ~/.cache/larch tmpdir patterns leaves Write denied and Step 4 cannot save the body
suggested_fix: In Step 2 mandate BUG_TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-bug-XXXXXX") (or equivalent under canonical /tmp) and state that all Write targets and --sentinel-file paths must live under $BUG_TMPDIR
